UPDATE intelligence_search_documents
        SET status = 'invalidated',
            source_revision = $7,
            source_updated_at = now(),
            invalidated_at = now(),
            invalidation_reason = $1,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE library_id = $2
          AND media_id = $3
          AND media_type = ($4::text)::media_type
          AND (
              $5::text = 'all'
              OR ($5::text = 'global' AND user_id IS NULL)
              OR ($5::text = 'user' AND user_id = $6)
          )
